data.name: Alice
data.message: Electrical done, heading upper engine next.

data.name: Eve
data.message: Doing engine output, then I need storage and weapons.

I reported Charlie’s body in Security. My route was Medbay -> Electrical -> Security. I saw Alice in Electrical around tick 5, then she left Electrical toward Medbay at tick 6. I went on to Security and found Charlie dead there. I didn’t see anyone else nearby or leaving Security.

I was mostly around Weapons this round. I dipped toward Security briefly and saw Charlie come in from Navigation around tick 6 — he was definitely alive then. I didn’t see anyone else with him, and I didn’t see Alice or Diana from my side.

If Diana found him in Security after coming from Electrical, then the kill had to be pretty recent after Charlie entered. I’d like to hear where Eve and Frank were, because I have zero info on them right now.

I started in Electrical, then went Medbay, then Upper Engine. I saw Alice enter Electrical from Security at tick 3, and Diana came into Electrical from Medbay at tick 4. Alice and Diana were both in Electrical around then.

At tick 6 I saw Alice come into Medbay from Electrical, then at tick 7 she left Medbay toward Upper Engine. I ended up in Upper Engine too and Alice was there with me at the end when the meeting got called. So Alice’s movement matches what Diana said, and I don’t think Alice could’ve done a recent kill in Security if Charlie was alive there around tick 6.

I didn’t see Bob or Frank at all. Based on what’s been said, the people with possible access to Security after Charlie was alive are Diana, Bob, and maybe Frank depending where he was. I’m not accusing yet, but Alice looks pretty clear to me from my perspective.

I don’t have much direct info, unfortunately. My route was Upper Engine -> Oxygen -> back through Upper Engine -> Lower Engine, and I didn’t run into anyone at all.

From what everyone’s said, Alice sounds pretty cleared by Eve and Diana’s timelines — she was seen moving away from Electrical/Medbay/Upper Engine, and if Charlie was alive in Security around tick 6, I don’t see Alice making that kill.

I was nowhere near Security, so from my perspective the main possibilities are Bob or Diana. Diana reported, but she was also the one who found it after coming from Electrical. Bob was the one closest from Weapons/Security side and says he saw Charlie alive entering Security, which also puts him near the body timing-wise.

I’d like to hear Alice’s final take, but right now I’m leaning suspicion on Bob or Diana, not Eve/Alice.

My route was Security -> Electrical -> Medbay -> Upper Engine.

I saw Bob enter Security from Weapons at tick 1, then I left toward Electrical. In Electrical I saw Eve around tick 3/4, and Diana came in from Medbay at tick 4. Diana and I were both in Electrical through about tick 6, then I went Medbay and saw Eve there around tick 7, and we ended in Upper Engine together. So Eve’s account matches mine, and Diana’s account of seeing me in Electrical also matches.

The key point is Bob says Charlie was alive entering Security around tick 6. If that’s true, I don’t think Eve or I could be the killer. Diana could have gone from Electrical to Security after that and reported, but Bob was already on the Weapons/Security side and admits he was near Security when Charlie was alive. Also I saw Bob in Security earlier, so he had been around that area.

Frank is unconfirmed, but his claimed route is far from Security. Between Bob and Diana, I’m more suspicious of Bob because he places himself near Charlie right before the death and didn’t really have anyone vouching for him. I think Bob is the best vote here.

I’ll restate mine clearly: I went Medbay -> Electrical -> Security. I saw Alice in Electrical around tick 5, and then Alice left Electrical toward Medbay at tick 6. I went straight to Security after that and found Charlie’s body there, and I reported immediately. I didn’t see Bob, Eve, or Frank near the body when I arrived.

Given everyone’s stories, Alice and Eve seem paired and their routes match. Frank is unconfirmed, but his claimed route is pretty far from Security. Bob is the one who admits being near Weapons/Security and says he saw Charlie alive entering Security right before the death. From my perspective, I know I didn’t kill, so Bob is the strongest suspect here.

I get why my name is coming up, but I think people are over-weighting “near Security” and under-weighting the timing.

Alice seeing me in Security at tick 1 is basically irrelevant to Charlie dying after tick 6. I was moving back and forth Weapons/Security, yes, and I saw Charlie enter Security from Navigation at tick 6 alive. After that I went back toward Weapons — that’s why Diana didn’t see me when she came in and reported.

If I were the killer, it would be really dumb for me to volunteer that Charlie was alive in Security right before the body was found, because that pins the timing directly around me. I gave that info because it narrows the kill window.

Diana is the one who says she went straight Electrical -> Security after Alice left and then immediately found the body. Nobody saw what happened between her leaving Electrical and reporting. Reporter isn’t auto-clear, especially when she’s the first confirmed person entering Security after Charlie was alive.

Frank is unconfirmed too, but based on routes, Diana has the cleanest path and timing to the body. I think this is more likely Diana than me.

I’m going to stick with my earlier timeline: I was Electrical -> Medbay -> Upper Engine. I saw Alice in Electrical, Diana came in from Medbay, then Alice went Electrical -> Medbay -> Upper Engine and ended with me. So I’m pretty confident Alice is not the killer here.

For the kill timing, Charlie was supposedly alive entering Security around tick 6. That really narrows it to someone who could be at Security right after that. Diana did go Electrical -> Security and reported, so she’s possible, but Bob also admits he was right on the Weapons/Security side and saw Charlie alive there. Nobody can vouch for Bob after that, and he had the closest access.

Frank is unconfirmed, but his claimed route is far from Security, so between the main suspects I’m leaning Bob over Diana. Reporter isn’t automatically clear, but Bob’s position and lack of vouch make him the strongest suspect to me.

I’ll restate my info quickly: I was not near Security at all. My route was Upper Engine -> Oxygen -> back through Upper Engine -> Lower Engine, and I didn’t see anyone the whole round.

Looking at everyone else’s timelines, Alice and Eve seem pretty strongly paired and their routes match. Diana is possible because she went Electrical -> Security and reported, but she was seen in Electrical around the time Alice left, so she would have had to go straight there, kill, and report.

Bob is the one who admits being right around Weapons/Security and seeing Charlie alive entering Security shortly before the body was found, with no one vouching for what he did after. His “I wouldn’t say that if I were killer” point doesn’t clear him for me — Ducks can give true timing to look helpful.

So for me it’s mostly between Bob and Diana, but I’m leaning Bob as the better vote.

My final take is still Bob.

My route was Security -> Electrical -> Medbay -> Upper Engine. I saw Bob enter Security from Weapons at tick 1, then I left. I was in Electrical with Eve and Diana around ticks 4-6, then went Medbay and Upper Engine with Eve seeing me. So Eve and I line up, and Diana’s account of seeing me in Electrical lines up too.

The kill window is after Bob says Charlie entered Security alive around tick 6. That means the killer had to be able to reach Security right then. Diana is possible because she went Electrical -> Security and reported, but Bob was already right on the Weapons/Security side, saw Charlie alive, and has no one confirming where he went after.

Frank is unconfirmed but claimed nowhere near Security. Between Bob and Diana, I think Bob has the strongest opportunity and weakest alibi. I’m voting Bob.
